lines: "With those results in hand and a strong start to the fourth quarter, we are raising our guidance for full-year AFFO per diluted share to a range of $8.87 to $8.97."
We now expect diluted earnings per share for fiscal year 2026 to be between $6.01 and $6.04, with diluted AFFO per share between $8.87 and $8.97.
